reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a cryptocurrency opportunity, claiming that the Split Program can double a token portfolio and that building a sales team can qualify viewers for bonuses. It urges viewers to register during a supposedly limited launch phase and provides opportunity-oriented contact or link context.

citations.quote: today you have the unique chance to participate in this success through a new currency called ONECoin
By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE coin, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team
The bonus plan lets you not only build a successful business, but gives you a chance to offer your contacts a way into profiting from the successful industry of cryptocurrency
Take your chance and register today!
We are in our first launch phase and have a limited number of positions available during this phase

opening.argument: The wording is qualified and opportunity-oriented rather than a direct guarantee. It describes a “chance” to participate, says the Split Program “can” double a portfolio, and limits the claim by saying that an increase depends on being active. Those conditions leave room for market risk and individual performance. The presentation also frames participation through learning and practice, not as automatic profit: viewers receive an education program, practice trading, and may exchange tokens once proficient. A careful judge should not convert conditional language and an educational context into a categorical promise of returns.

citations.quote: today you have the unique chance to participate in this success through a new currency called ONECoin
The Split program can double your token's portfolio.
if you are active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under ten weeks
these tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members, practice your skills

rebuttal.rebuttal: The quoted doubling language is expressly “can,” not “will,” and the timeframe is conditioned on being active. Likewise, “exciting bonuses” describes eligibility, not a guaranteed payment. The registration language identifies a launch-phase availability limit, but does not itself establish deception. The prosecution's reading removes the qualifications that a viewer is told to consider.

citations.quote: The Split program can double your token's portfolio.
if you are active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under ten weeks
you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses
We are in our first launch phase and have a limited number of positions available during this phase

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Conditional wording does not make the opportunity neutral when the presentation still highlights portfolio doubling, rapid value increases, bonuses, and immediate registration. The relevant qualification is only that the viewer be “active”; it does not identify a meaningful risk, possible loss, or uncertainty about receiving benefits. The speaker also says the bonus plan offers contacts a way into profiting, which goes beyond merely warning viewers to assess risk.

citations.quote: The Split program can double your token's portfolio.
you can increase your portfolio value in just under ten weeks
The bonus plan lets you not only build a successful business, but gives you a chance to offer your contacts a way into profiting from the successful industry of cryptocurrency

opening.argument: The primary substance is an educational and operational explanation of a cryptocurrency program. The speaker says viewers will learn trading strategies, receive education packages, practice with tokens, and use a back office to follow their portfolio and business progress. That is consistent with presenting a training pathway and demonstrating how participation is organized. The material does not merely tell viewers to send money; it explains an academy, trading practice, an exchange, and account features. References to possible profit describe the subject being taught, while the central format remains instruction about cryptocurrency operations.

citations.quote: Onecoin will be introduced through our Education Program where you learn about trading strategies and how to profit from trading with cryptocurrency.
these tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members, practice your skills
As a member, you will get your own back office where you will learn
follow the progress of the business and stay updated on the latest news

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material educational does not answer its explicit commercial invitation. The speaker does not simply explain cryptocurrency in the abstract: he promotes OneCoin, describes an active marketing-partner role, ties bonuses to building a sales team, and ends by telling viewers to register. The training language therefore functions as the route into the promoted opportunity, not as detached instruction.

citations.quote: By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE coin, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team
Take your chance and register today!
Onecoin will be introduced through our Education Program

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The operational detail is not incidental: the education packages are presented as the way to obtain tokens and participate in trading, while the back office tracks the business and portfolio. Most importantly, the speaker expressly shifts from teaching to recruiting, saying that popularizing OneCoin and building a sales team qualifies the participant for bonuses. A tutorial framing cannot erase that direct recruitment instruction.

citations.quote: With our education packages you will receive free trading tokens so-called one tokens
By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE coin, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team
Follow your token's portfolio via the back-office and see it grow through our Split program

opening.argument: The supplied material does not establish the core mechanics of a scam. It describes education packages, free practice tokens, an exchange, and a member back office, but does not state that viewers must make a deposit, pay an entry fee, surrender credentials, or receive guaranteed returns. It also does not explain how any sales-team compensation is calculated or show that recruiting alone produces income. The contact frame supplies a way to obtain more information, while the narration presents a product-and-service package whose safety or profitability cannot be certified from this record. Missing mechanisms matter when the claim is being classified from evidence rather than assumption.

citations.quote: With our education packages you will receive free trading tokens so-called one tokens
these tokens will give you the possibility for trading in on our exchange with thousands of other members
As a member, you will get your own back office

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a stated deposit does not make the promotion ordinary commerce when the speaker links bonuses to building a sales team and asks viewers to register. The mechanism that matters here is expressly identified: active marketing-partner status, popularizing OneCoin, and sales-team building. The prosecution need not invent a fee or credential request to rely on those stated recruitment conditions.

citations.quote: By becoming an active marketing partner of the ONE network, and by popularizing ONE coin, you will be able to qualify for exciting bonuses by building your own sales team
Take your chance and register today!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing deposit language is not decisive because the material plainly describes a tiered recruitment incentive: bonus eligibility depends on becoming a marketing partner and building a sales team, and contacts are offered a route into profit. The education package and tokens are the surrounding sales structure, while the explicit compensation condition supplies the relevant mechanism. A contact prompt and product branding reinforce that this is an active solicitation, not merely a neutral service description.
